newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Kohl says EMU to start with five to seven members.
newsitem.headline: Kohl says EMU to start with five to seven members.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl said on Tuesday that the European single currency would probably begin with five to seven European Union members.
"There will be five, six or seven, in any case a sufficient number," Kohl said in a speech during a visit to Argentina. He declined to give an exact number.
Kohl repeated that the entry criteria for economic and monetary union must not be changed despite attempts by some to loosen them.
He said Germany still had to make considerable efforts to ensure that it qualified for EMU although the economy was now coming out of its recent slowdown.
"We are on the move in Germany," Kohl said.
